name: Becker Law
about: Becker Law is a personal injury firm with a single office in Buffalo.
The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours, photo count and description come from the Places API. The services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way.

score.verdict: All 5 eligibility gates passed. Strongest pillar: A; most headroom in pillar D (4/25).

subs.label: Experience
subs.evidence: Mean 27.0 years since admission across 1 of 1 named attorneys (longest 27, shortest 27) · NYS Attorney Registration database

subs.label: Roster verifiability
subs.evidence: 1 of 1 named attorneys matched to the New York register; bar numbers published on the bios

subs.label: Accountability
subs.evidence: no bar or trial lawyers' association named on the pages we read · no professional liability cover disclosed, which is not scored here: plaintiff firms in this market do not publish it, and an absence shared by every firm separates none of them

subs.label: Results published
subs.evidence: 9 results published on the firm's own site, counted from stated amounts

subs.label: Specificity
subs.evidence: 2 case types named; no court or county named, so no result can be looked up

subs.label: Results disclosure
subs.evidence: No prior-results disclaimer on the results page, which the New York advertising rules effectively require

subs.label: Authentic volume
subs.evidence: 48 Google reviews · Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

subs.label: Rating quality
subs.evidence: Google rating 4.8 over 48 reviews → Bayesian 4.82 (prior 4.83 weighted as 100 reviews, from 300 scored firms) · single platform, Google only

subs.label: Review recency
subs.evidence: 1 of 5 sampled reviews are from the last 12 months (newest 2026-06-05) · a sample of five per business listing, not every review

subs.label: Complaint share
subs.evidence: 0 of 5 sampled reviews rate 1 or 2 stars · a sample, so this is the shape of the complaints rather than a count of them

subs.label: Website trust & experience
subs.evidence: CWV fail · no bar numbers on bios · no fee statement · privacy policy · no disclaimer · fresh content

subs.label: Search authority
subs.evidence: DR 4.1 → 5th pct of 22-firm cohort (median 19) 0/3 · 443 referring domains, 14th pct 0/2 · 4 organic keywords / 15 visits·mo, 4th pct 0/2 · brand demand 0/1 (pending)

subs.label: Local presence
subs.evidence: 1 operational Google Business Profile listing · 10 or more photos, which is where the API stops counting · 5 categories, hours published, which almost every listing here has and so separates nobody · the services list, Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the Places API does not expose, and NAP consistency across citations and local-pack rank have no source here, so the rest of this sub-factor leaves the scale rather than being scored as unearned

subs.label: Content, E-E-A-T & schema
subs.evidence: JSON-LD detected 1/1 · not assessed on any firm yet, so content depth and earned media and AI citations leave the scale (4 pts)

subs.label: Free consult & fee transparency
subs.evidence: Free consultation · Contingency · the fee percentage itself is not published
